items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I know Zutty was there for a long time

ctx.x: And, then, it became the Hot Seven--- it's history of those guys and if you'd sit and look at the record - you'd know who was in that band--- I know Zutty was there for a long time, and there was a time when Earl Hines played and then, of course, there was Jimmy Noone at the -- Jimmy Noone was playing - well, right across the streetpractically -- I used to go over there too and then, Earl went in there for awhile - Earl Hines played with him and I used to hang around---those are my hangouts---
Where was King Oliver at that point---
